content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JNCASR Junior Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Junior Site Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 13 September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Site Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification. Additionally, a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in construction, civil, or maintenance works is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Site Engineer post is 32 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Site Engineer position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Site Engineer post in this recruitment drive by JNCASR.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for JNCASR Junior Site Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Site Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview conducted by a committee. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the JNCASR Junior Site Engineer recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their application and required documents to the official email address provided.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Junior Site Engineer position is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a specified period, as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where is JNCASR located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
